assumptions: 90-foot baseball baseline used as scale prior.
River water is local zero; field +12m, site +8m, canopy +48m, tower +68m are image-informed estimates.
Plan map origin and home plate differ by an estimated 33m east-west registration adjustment to place field consistently beside the rendered riverfront.
Four plan anchors establish approximately 2.4m per pixel; stadium glyph is not treated as a dimensioned ballfield.

rf_scoreboard.basis: V4: three-ray triangulation of the board top centre from the north (px 279,514 of 1944x1294), south and bridge fits gives [101.7,36.9,37.8] with 0.4/2.0/2.1 m ray misses; the V3 anchor [96.9,25.4,38] was a single-height back-projection and lay 5.2 m inside the field polygon. The board is placed 4.3 m east of the triangulated centre so the whole 36 m board, its service platform and both pylon footprints clear the traced outfield wall (first V4 pass at x 104.6 left the north pylon 0.5-0.9 m inside the polygon at the wall bend; see review/rf-plan-evidence.json), rotated 92 deg (north-image top corners suggest a slight cant toward home). Width/height reduced from 39x20 to 36x18.5 from the north-image corner rays; still inferred.
